disk_budget_bytes.label: Directory-index disk budget
disk_budget_bytes.description: Total managed directory-index storage, including retained data, WAL and operation headroom.

inactive_retention_seconds.label: Inactive-source retention
inactive_retention_seconds.description: Maximum retention after the last index access. Inactive sources can be removed earlier for disk pressure.

max_retained_inactive_sources.label: Retained inactive sources
max_retained_inactive_sources.description: Maximum retained inactive source databases. This does not limit active sources or directory coverage.

page_cache_kib.label: SQLite page-cache target
page_cache_kib.description: Page-cache target per SQLite connection in KiB. This is not a process memory limit.

healthy_verification_seconds.label: Healthy verification interval
healthy_verification_seconds.description: Full verification interval for active sources with healthy observation.

degraded_verification_seconds.label: Degraded verification interval
degraded_verification_seconds.description: Full verification interval when observation is unavailable or uncertain. It must not exceed the healthy interval.
